text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Man, to think we haven't seen any results 
up to this point. How should we interpret 
this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Was my hypothesis fundamentally wrong all 
along? Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Was my hypothesis fundamentally wrong all 
along? Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Why are you stating the 
obvious?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If it's wrong, we just rethink it! Right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Brace yourself. Things are about to get 
even busier from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I must re-examine all the data collected 
so far and continue my research!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was merely thinking that I'll have to 
formulate a new hypothesis, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Being down in the dumps lacks 
productivity. We have no time for that!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I will turn everything into fuel. I'll 
show you my answer in the next race!
